# Plans are generated by rules, not an LLM

Plans, Suggestions and Progression come from deterministic rules over the Goal, Focus Areas, Repertoire, Inventory, Limitations, Cardio Habits and availability. An LLM was the obvious alternative, but it would need a network, an API key and per-use costs, and its output can't be pinned down by tests. Rules keep the app offline, free and test-first. An LLM could later be layered on top, but never as the only source of a Plan.
